Choice.description: One offered answer to a human question, with its consequences.

consequences.description: What happens if this choice is picked, so the human can weigh it.
consequences.title: Consequences

id.description: Id the human's answer cites to pick this choice.
id.title: Id

label.description: The wording shown to the human.
label.title: Label

schema_version.description: Version of this contract's shape, so a reader can reject a payload written for another shape.
schema_version.title: Schema Version

Choice.title: Choice

choices.description: Answers offered to the human, each with its consequences.
choices.title: Choices

decision_id.description: The decision the question belongs to, so the answer returns to it.
decision_id.title: Decision Id

evidence_ids.description: Evidence the question rests on (shown to the human as relevant evidence).
evidence_ids.title: Evidence Ids

free_text_allowed.description: Whether the human may answer in their own words.
free_text_allowed.title: Free Text Allowed

schema_version.description: Version of this contract's shape, so a reader can reject a payload written for another shape.
schema_version.title: Schema Version

structured_allowed.description: Whether the human may answer with an approve-or-edit answer about proposed criteria and options.
structured_allowed.title: Structured Allowed

subject_ids.description: Ids of the options or criteria the question is about; a structured answer may cite only these.
subject_ids.title: Subject Ids

why_research_cannot_settle.description: Why evidence cannot settle this, shown so the human understands why they are asked.
why_research_cannot_settle.title: Why Research Cannot Settle
